name: Hextar Global Berhad
overview: 2026年，Hextar Global Berhad 提议将业务多元化至物业发展、建筑及物业投资与管理，并拟通过合资公司 Hextar Siera Sdn Bhd 开展综合开发项目；同时，公司拟进行多项收购（涉及农业相关公司），但收购条件期限多次延长。此外，公司通过间接子公司完成了三块农业地的出售，总现金代价为 RM13,750,000。
overview_en: In 2026, Hextar Global Berhad proposed to diversify into property development, construction, and property investment and management, and planned to undertake a mixed-use development project through a joint venture company, Hextar Siera Sdn Bhd. Concurrently, the company proposed several acquisitions (involving agriculture-related companies), with the conditional periods repeatedly extended.

segments.name: 农业
segments.note: 今年公司提议收购农业相关公司，但收购条件期限多次延长；同时，一家间接子公司完成了三块农业地的出售。
segments.note_en: This year, the company proposed acquisitions of agriculture-related companies, with the conditional periods repeatedly extended;

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 提议收购农业相关公司，并将收购条件期限延长至2026年12月31日。
actions.text_en: Proposed acquisitions of agriculture-related companies, with the conditional period extended to 31 December 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 签订补充协议，修订收购条款，将收购PKF 60,000,000股普通股（现金代价RM65.50百万）从拟议收购中排除。
actions.text_en: Entered into supplemental agreements to amend acquisition terms, excluding the proposed acquisition of 60,000,000 ordinary shares in PKF for a cash consideration of RM65.50 million from the proposed acquisitions.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 将收购条件期限延长3个月至2026年9月22日。
actions.text_en: Extended the conditional period by 3 months to 22 September 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 间接子公司PHG Ever Fresh Plantation Sdn. Bhd.完成向Chateau MSK Sdn. Bhd.出售三块永久农业地，总现金代价RM13,750,000。
actions.text_en: Indirect subsidiary PHG Ever Fresh Plantation Sdn. Bhd. completed the disposal of three freehold agricultural land parcels to Chateau MSK Sdn. Bhd. for a total cash consideration of RM13,750,000.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 就开发土地买卖协议，将余额订金支付期限延长至2026年10月30日。
actions.text_en: Extended the payment period for the balance deposit under the development land sale and purchase agreement to 30 October 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 提议将业务多元化至物业发展、建筑及物业投资与管理，并拟通过合资公司Hextar Siera Sdn Bhd开展综合开发项目。
actions.text_en: Proposed diversification into property development, construction, and property investment and management, and proposed a joint venture through Hextar Siera Sdn Bhd to undertake a mixed-use development project.
